name: Joyería Revello
description: Uruguayan online jewelry and watch store selling rings, wedding bands, chains, bracelets, pendants, earrings and watches in gold and silver, with prices in USD. Home delivery takes about 3 to 5 business days and orders can be picked up in two Montevideo shopping-center stores.
